description: Who's Afraid of Little Old Me? is mother absolutely UNLEASHED and it is terrifying in the best way 😤🔥 'You should be' is the coldest line of the entire TTPD era. She's singing about being this monster everyone made her into and the circus imagery is genius. It's dramatic, it's dark, and I am living for the lore. A full villain origin story in song form 💅✨
